scope: Internal diagnostic only. No public option, FFI, point correction, q1 formula or solver change. Approximate h is an explicitly off-contract research input to the exact-h candidate.

development.geometry: Actual generic-JLA attachment diagnostics from fixed outcome-free prepass y=X beta with deterministic nonzero coefficients and oracle covariance variance 1e-8. Capture failures are retained. Current per-outcome command addressing is not qualified.
development.jla_options: Diagonal full-quotient route, default JLA phase tolerances, batches 16; geometry-only oracle attachment uses 32 covariance probes, 8 spectrum probes, 128 iterations, q0. No attachment result is used as a simulated interval.
development.selection: Do not tune the fitter or choose a passing seed. Confirm exact inputs and the largest predeclared JLA budget (3200), using a new fixed numerical seed. Smaller budgets diagnose sensitivity only.

same_design.population: Identical original physical observation population, target matrices, outcomes and true variances. Independent physical errors; no controls. Collapse each match to sum(y)/sqrt(F), Xg=sqrt(F)X, variance=sum(sigma2)/F. Whole-match and observation deletion point corrections need not coincide.
same_design.interpretation: Diagnostic comparison, not a new match coverage claim. Verify collapsed isometry and a tiny independent physical-block deletion oracle. Record grouped variance-basis misspecification and all training-support failures.

confirmation.cells: All 20 cell/dimension entries of the original rc_observation_inference.rs confirmation matrix
confirmation.gate_source: Unchanged _scientific_failures and _spectral_failures in fevc/tools/run_structured_inference_confirmation.py; adapt new summaries without weakening original cutoffs or exclusions.
confirmation.freeze: Before generating confirmation outcomes, freeze machine-readable task manifest and immutable source bundle containing harness, core, lockfiles, original oracle and validator. Bind executable and all geometry inputs by SHA256. No estimator or harness tuning during confirmation. A failing campaign remains failing.
confirmation.rng: Counter-V1 Diagnostic domain; semantic master/cell/k/replication seed and canonical physical-row index; two-word cosine Box-Muller. Student-t8 uses independent numerator and eight denominator normals. Paired arms consume identical outcomes; task order and shards cannot change draws.
confirmation.limits: Conditional variance-learning experiment with exact point kernels, exact covariance traces and deterministic q1 reference quadrature. Not end-to-end public JLA, Monte Carlo covariance, joint-target PSD, general match dependence or native platform qualification. Null cells are diagnostic; q1 covariance multi-mode target retains original exclusion.

harness_gates: Tiny end-to-end output, validation and receipt
Malformed, duplicate, missing, partial, nonfinite and scientifically failing rows
Outcome-free spectral, support, maker, basis identification and true variance preflight
Count every attempted fit and target; report all failure cells
stop_rule: Complete all local stages and audit even if scientific gates fail; do not promote based on developmental coverage or weaken confirmation thresholds.
